"''Their shipbuilding business has hit some hard times. House Inrokini bailed them out with a huge investment, so they're the real power these days. Not that Mitth advertises the fact, of course.|[[Theron Shan]] and [[Pova]]|{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20171116|text="Chasing Copero"|int=Chasing Copero}}}} '''Copero''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was the location of the Chiss' largest [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]. ==Description== [[File:Copero_Ancient_ruins_concept_art.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ancient ruins on Copero]] Copero was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Copero system/Legends|Copero system]] of Chiss Space in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Under the control of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], it was home to the [[Mitth family/Legends|Mitth family]], one of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]], and thus was located on the [[Path of the Houses]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through the Ascendancy's core territory, along with the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of many other Ruling Families. Copero was also the location of the Chiss Ascendancy's largest [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]. The planet had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and was predominantly covered in mountains. ===Fauna=== The colder, icier areas of the planet were populated by large, [[Hair/Legends|hairy]] [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] and [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Pantran whitefang]]s. The [[Barbed ginx|Ginx]] and [[Orobird/Legends|Orobird]] inhabited the planet's urban areas. ==History== [[File:Sith_Emperors_holomap_on_Copero.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sith Emperor's holomap was kept in secret on Copero.]] After the revelation that [[Theron Shan]] was the traitor behind the attacks on [[Iokath]] and [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], the [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] broadcasted a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide message on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] asking for any information about Shan's location.{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Crisis on Umbara}} The message reached [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] from the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] who personally arrived at the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]], revealing that Shan was on Copero under protection of [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] from [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]]. Trying to solve both problems, Saganu asked the Commander to deal with both traitors. After arriving on Copero, [[Raina Temple]] from the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and the Commander [[Mission to Copero|fought]] their way through the [[Copero City|city]], eventually reaching Zenta in the [[Inrokini Stronghold|Inrokini shipyard]]. After a small confrontation Zenta revealed that Shan betrayed her. Shan, who previously obtained information about Copero, was only after a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] kept in the [[Ancient ruins (Copero)|ancient ruins]] that had the location to a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] stored by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. After Shan learned about the superweapon's location, he destroyed the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminal. As Shan and [[Valss]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], prepared to leave, the Commander and Temple arrived to stop them, but Valss stayed behind to buy Shan enough time to escape. After the Commander killed Valss, they returned to Odessen and tried to figure out Shan's next move. ==Behind the scenes== Copero was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-9. ==Appearances== *[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}} *{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20171116|text="Chasing Copero"|int=Chasing Copero}} {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Copero}} *''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' {{1stm}} *{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20171002-0|text=''Star Wars''™: The Old Republic™ -
